articles.title: US Blocks Foreign-Made Routers on Security Grounds
articles.summary: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has placed foreign-made consumer-grade routers on its Covered List. This significant move aims to enhance national security by prohibiting new models of these routers from entering the U.S. market. It reflects growing concerns over supply chain integrity and potential cybersecurity vulnerabilities in critical consumer technology, safeguarding against foreign espionage.

articles.title: Indonesian Navy weighs missile options for new warship
articles.summary: Indonesia's navy is evaluating missile systems from Italy, France, and Turkiye to equip its newly arrived warship, KRI Prabu Siliwangi-321. This strategic acquisition aims to enhance the vessel's combat capabilities and modernize Indonesia's naval fleet. The decision reflects Indonesia's commitment to strengthening its maritime defence, ensuring regional security and protecting its vast territorial waters through advanced weaponry.
